design: Very tall lanky keeper with a wide rear skull and deeply furrowed forehead, correctly separated four mandibles, short thick black scalp tendrils fanning behind crown. Narrow dark-purple robe with long asymmetric hanging sleeves and a broad loose cowl resting below neck. Left forearm carries a tall narrow teal ceremonial slate upright, right index claw points to an abstract engraved mark. Pale grey-green scales.
